items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: It was me, David Williams, who was from Trinidad; and Elvin; and Ryo Kawasaki was from Japan.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s just understand — that goes on. At that time when that used to go on on Buddy’s band, not so much the members of the band but we would play Florida and Ernie Watts and Charlie Owens could not swim in the swimming pool, and this was, we’re talking about ’69, 70 you know. Elvin’s band was not so much amongst the band members, it was more or less sometimes people who assumed certain things in Europe, that the band was all black and then I show up. At certain times I was the only white guy on the band.…

Elvin. Elvin didn’t see color. He was not — no never. We got off a train one time in Germany and the guy that booked us was this whole German Luftwaffe pilot who basically met us at the train. It was me, David Williams, who was from Trinidad; and Elvin; and Ryo Kawasaki was from Japan. And he comes up with a German accent and he says, “Well I thought you was an all-colored band?” He tells Elvin. And Elvin goes, “Well, we’re all colors,” he said.
That’s a good one. Well music is just like every other part of society you know, it’s everywhere.
